hero.subtitle: We design and integrate physical security systems and specialized technologies, from technical assessment through commissioning and maintenance.

servicios.card1_desc: We assess site conditions, operational requirements and risks to define the architecture and scope of each project.
servicios.card2_desc: We source and supply equipment, integrate it with existing systems, and train the teams responsible for using it.
servicios.card3_desc: We install, configure and validate each solution before commissioning, then provide maintenance to help keep systems available.
servicios.heading: Security & technology integration services
servicios.heading_desc: We design, supply and integrate solutions that protect assets and keep critical facilities operating. We complement each project with technical training for your teams.
servicios.process_heading: From technical assessment to ongoing support

expansion.ref_steg: Société Tunisienne de l'Électricité et du Gaz (STEG)
expansion.intro: NOVAXIS was founded in Gabès, Tunisia, in 2009 as a physical security engineering company. Since then, it has supported governments, international organizations and industrial complexes in more than 8 countries.
expansion.item1_desc: Creation of NOVAXIS in Tunisia, specialized in physical security, networks and engineering solutions.
expansion.item2_desc: United Nations (UNIOGBIS) in Guinea-Bissau, Sri Lanka Navy and Libya's High National Election Commission (HNEC).
expansion.item3_desc: Protection of government infrastructure and electronic security for strategic infrastructure in Mauritania and Ukraine.
expansion.item4_desc: World Bank work in Tunisia, the IAEA/ABEN nuclear project in Bolivia and the creation of NOVAXIS LATAM ENGINEERING, with a regional presence in Bolivia, Panama, Honduras and Colombia.
expansion.cta_desc: Do you have a project in Bolivia, Panama, Honduras or Latin America? We'll support you wherever you need it.

sectores.title: Experience in critical sectors
sectores.card1_desc: Physical security and access control for energy facilities, with video surveillance and perimeter detection that protect operational continuity.
sectores.card2_desc: Security and integration systems for government buildings, electoral processes and international organizations, with the level of confidentiality they require.
sectores.card3_desc: Protection of plants and industrial complexes with access control, video surveillance and alarms integrated into a single platform.
sectores.card4_desc: Security for research reactors, nuclear medicine centers and radiotherapy services, where protecting people, equipment and radioactive sources is the priority.
sectores.card5_desc: Access control and surveillance for ports, terminals and logistics areas, with traceability of people and vehicles.

nuclear.title: Security for nuclear research and radiotherapy
nuclear.desc: We protect research reactors, nuclear medicine centers and radiotherapy services: facilities devoted to science and healthcare, where the physical security of people, equipment and radioactive sources is a constant requirement.
nuclear.item2_desc: Continuous coverage of entrances, treatment rooms, laboratories and perimeters, with recording and traceability of every event.
nuclear.item3_desc: Perimeter detection and access by zone and authorization level, to safeguard radioactive sources, equipment and work areas.
nuclear.item4_desc: A single system that unites video surveillance, access control and alarms, with the documentation needed for audits and for dialogue with the regulatory authority.

equipo.desc: Professionals experienced in maintenance, equipment evaluation, and technical support for industrial, scientific, and nuclear projects.
